data.title: Suspected scam: fake change of bank details from "Stadtwerke"
data.summary: A letter dated 7 September 2026, claiming to be from Stadtwerke Musterstadt, says its bank details have changed. It demands €214.00 by 11 September 2026 to a new IBAN and threatens to cut off power. It shows several signs of fraud.
data.explanation: This letter looks like a payment scam. Real utilities rarely change their bank account by letter, and they don't demand immediate payment to a different account holder under threat of disconnection without notice. The new account belongs to "Global Energy Payments s.r.o.", which is not the Stadtwerke. The letter also tells you not to reply and to call only a mobile number. Don't pay and don't call that number. Check your contract or latest bill for the Stadtwerke's real contact details, and ask them whether the letter is genuine. If you have already paid, contact your bank at once. You can also report it to the police or the consumer advice centre (Verbraucherzentrale).
